description: Connect ChatGPT to your Tamarind Bio workspace for protein and molecular science. Validate, estimate, submit, and monitor jobs across 300+ tools — structure prediction, docking, protein and antibody design, molecular dynamics, and property prediction. Chain tools into pipelines, batch many inputs at once, and pull back structures, results, and logs — all from chat.

defaultPrompt: Predict the structure of KRAS G12C and return the top-ranked model with confidence metrics.
Design nanobody binders to PD-L1, then refold and rank the best candidates.
Dock imatinib into ABL1 kinase and summarize the highest-confidence poses.
